## War Bringer Giant (CR 19)

**XP** 204,800  
CE Huge monstrous humanoid (giant)  
**Init** +5; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +35  


**Defense**


**AC** 22, touch 10, flat-footed 20 (+1 dodge, +12 armor, +1 Dex, -2 size)  
**hp** 406 (28d10+252); **DR** 10/lawful; fast healing 20/lawful; **SR** 25  
**Fort** +18, **Ref** +13, **Will** +20  
**Defensive Abilities** unstoppable  
**Immune** 75% immunity to critical hits (from armor), ability score damage/drain, the fatigued and exhausted conditions, non-lethal damage, mind-affecting abilities  
**Weaknesses** spell vulnerability (calm emotions)  


**Offense**


**Speed** 60 ft.  
**Melee** +48/+43/+38/+33 earthbreaker (2d10+20 bludgeoning plus reposition, 20/x3) or +48 Vital Strike earthbreaker (8d10+20 bludgeoning plus reposition, 20/x3)  
**Special Attacks** Mythic Surge (5x/day, +1d10)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 20th concentration +21)  

At Will—earthquake (only via warhammer), rage (Will DC 25, only via warhammer) \  


**Statistics**


**Str** 43, **Dex** 13, **Con** 29, **Int** 9, **Wis** 18, **Cha** 13  
**Base Atk** +28; **CMB** +46 (+48 to bull rush, overrun, reposition); **CMD** 58 (immune to drag, reposition, trip)  
**Feats** Cleave, Great Cleave, Greater Bull Rush, Greater Overrun, Greater Penetrating Strike, Greater Reposition, Greater Vital Strike, [Powerful Maneuvers](../../rules/feats/powerful-maneuvers.md), Improved Reposition, Improved Vital Strike, Penetrating Strike, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (warhammer), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Improved Bull Rush, Improved Overrun are covered by Powerful Maneuvers; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility, Improved Initiative.*  
**Skills** Climb +47, Intimidate +32, Perception +35  
**Languages** Common, Giant, Orc  
**Gear** +4 earthbreaker, +3 full plate of heavy fortification  


**Special Abilities**


**Slammed Into the Sky (Ex)** A War bringer giant hits like a siege engine. The war bringer giant may make a free Reposition combat maneuver against any target it strikes with its warhammer.
